author: Brandi Blake
title: Road closure announced in Summers County - NewsBreak
text:
By Brandi Blake No media credit provided. ,
7 hours ago
SUMMERS COUNTY, WV (WVNS) — The West Virginia Division of Highways (WVDOH) announced an upcoming road closure in Summers County.
According to a press release, County Route 7, Ramp Road, will be closed at milepost 20.21, beginning at 8 a.m. and ending at 5 p.m. on Friday, June 5 2026. The closure is to allow for an emergency pipe replacement and embankment stabilization. Inclement weather or unforeseen circumstances may change the progress or schedule of the project.
WVDOH expresses their apologies for any issues this may cause to residents in the area and asks that all travelers observe traffic control signs, use alternate routes, and remain aware of their surroundings while in and around the work zone.
